title: Juniper and the Border
premise: Rafael Eastwick, a sleepless private security contractor haunted by a mission gone wrong, is approached by Juniper, a stranger who claims he once saved her life — a favor he has no memory of. She reveals that the 'incident' was no accident: the shadowy training network that made Rafael into an operative has been erasing its own assets, and his missing memory hides proof of who ordered it. As they trace the network's handlers across borders, Rafael discovers Juniper is the daughter of the program's founder, raised inside it and now burning it from within. In the end, they expose the archive to the one journalist still alive who will print it, and Rafael chooses found family over the identity the network built for him.
about_author: Astrid Almeida is a former border-region aid worker turned novelist, known for thrillers steeped in the moral fog of security contracting. She writes at night, she says, because that's when the truth keeps its appointments.

chapters.title: The Favor That Never Happened
chapters.summary: POV: Rafael. Insomniac and half-dissolved by guilt over a client extraction that killed two of his team, Rafael is confronted in a Lisbon bar by Juniper, who thanks him for saving her life three years ago — a night he cannot remember. She leaves a burner phone and a warning: someone is closing accounts. The beat is unease; the past has arrived with a bill attached.

chapters.title: Interest Owed
chapters.summary: POV: alternating Rafael and Juniper. When Rafael's handler turns up dead within hours of their meeting, he runs with Juniper, who reveals she grew up inside the Meridian Program — the black training network that shaped operatives like him and is now erasing them. A raid on a safehouse yields a partial ledger bearing Rafael's own codename. The beat is reluctant alliance hardening into purpose.

chapters.title: What the Training Built
chapters.summary: POV: Rafael. Following the ledger to a decommissioned facility on the Spanish border, Rafael recovers fragments of his lost night: he did save Juniper, then let the program wipe him to survive. Ambushed by a cleanup team led by his old mentor Callas, he must fight the very instincts he was trained to trust. The climax breaks him open — loyalty to the network dies here.

chapters.title: Juniper and the Border
chapters.summary: POV: Juniper. With Callas hunting them and the archive set to be destroyed at dawn, Juniper leads the crossing she was literally designed to guard against, using her founder-father's own protocols against him. They transmit the ledger before the burn, and Callas falls to the system he served. The resolution: two orphans of the same machine walk out as family, and Rafael finally sleeps.
